about: Two-finger touchpad swipes on Windows, followed as they move (windows/src/Swipe.cs, feature win.swipe). Each case is a list of events: ["wheel", t ms, horizontal delta (+ scrolls right), vertical delta]; ["drag", from, to, every ms, horizontal delta] (one wheel message every so often, from and to included); ["touch", from, to] (the touchpad's reports every 8 ms: fingers down); ["limit", lo, hi]; ["poll", t]; ["progress"] (writes p=<progress, 2 places>). expect lists what came out: started, back, options, cancel, and the progress lines. 480 units is the whole animation; lifting past half way goes through, a flick of 2000 units a second decides by its direction, and the coasting after a lift is ignored. Windows only: the phone's swipes go to the previous or next story (phone.swipe), so only windows/tests/Tests.cs reads this file.

cases.name: a slow drag past half way, then lift: back
past half way and back again before the lift: springs back
past the start into the other way: options
a quick flick short of half way: goes through
a quick flick back toward the start: springs back though past half way
resting before the lift: an earlier quick move is no flick
coasting after the lift is ignored; the next swipe starts when the fingers come down
Options already open: scrolling right goes nowhere, and turning back moves at once
a diagonal page scroll never starts one
scrolling down first: starts once across is twice the down
a tilt wheel (no touchpad reports) ends at a pause
the tick count wrapping past int's top doesn't break a swipe
